hooks.name: aidlc-plan-approval-guard
hooks.description:
Blocks Code Generation dispatch and workspace mutation until the exact active plan has a human-owned approval receipt.

Migration note: Tool categories were converted to the tool-name matcher `^(fs_write|fs_append|str_replace|delete_file|code|execute_bash|execute_pwsh|control_bash_process|control_pwsh_process|list_processes|get_process_output)$`, reconstructed from the built-in tool list. Confirm it covers the tools you meant, then enable the hook. Tool categories [subagent, .*invoke_sub_agent.*] are not recognized and contributed no tool names.
